title: MCSO: Duo found with nearly 2 pounds of meth - NewsBreak
text:
By A Mingo Messenger Staff Report ,
14 hours ago Two individuals were jailed after police allegedly discovered a cache of drugs and cash in their possession. According to Mingo County Magistrate Court documents, on June 9, officers with the Mingo County Sheriff’s Office and the U.S. 119 Drug Task Force conducted a “knock and talk” at a Big Splint Hollow residence after receiving complaints from residents in the community that suspected drug activity was taking place at a nearby residence where Mary Lou Sidney, 36, of South Williamson, Kentucky, and Eric Devale Mitchell-Rodgers, 31, of Detroit, Michigan, were staying.
